planned_math_to_code.statement: Decompose Uhat=Q Uhat+(I-Q)Uhat into orthogonal components.
If Rhat=A diag(s) B^T, R*=A diag((s-lambda)_+) B^T.
Set U'=Q Uhat+R*; Q U'=Q Uhat and e0^T U'=e0^T Uhat.
